events.title: Flamenco - Rosas Negras
events.intro: Das neue Programm von ROSAS NEGRAS präsentiert intensiven und authentischen Flamenco mit einem breiten Spektrum dieser Jahrhunderte alten Kunst. Das Konzert vereint Dramatik und Sensibilität, Tradition und Moderne, Sinnlichkeit und Intimität.

events.title: »Alice im Wunderland« Orchestererzählung von Henrik Albrecht
events.intro: A family concert featuring Henrik Albrecht's orchestral narrative of Alice in Wonderland, performed with scenic spoken texts by actors of the bremer shakespeare company and the Landesjugendorchester Bremen. Suitable for children aged 6 and above.

events.title: Philharmonie der Solisten »Vivaldi – Die vier Jahreszeiten«
program: Antonio Vivaldi: Die vier Jahreszeiten op. 8/1-4
events.intro: The Philharmonie der Solisten, an ensemble of professionally trained musicians who each perform as soloists, presents Vivaldi's Four Seasons alongside works by Mozart, Bach, and Brahms. The concert is led by violinist Vladik Otaryan.

events.title: »Curtis on Tour« 8. Philharmonisches Kammerkonzert
program: Ludwig van Beethoven: Klaviertrio D-Dur op. 70/1 (»Geistertrio«)
events.intro: The Curtis on Tour Ensemble, led by violinist Liza Ferschtman and pianist Benjamin Hochman, presents a chamber music program featuring works by Martinů, Beethoven, and Brahms. The concert brings together young musicians from the Curtis Institute of Music on a European tour.

events.title: Dennis Alexander Volk »Storytelling Piano«
events.intro: Pianist, yoga teacher and author Dennis Alexander Volk presents an evening of meditative piano music combined with readings from his book »Storytelling Piano« and compositions from his new album.
